edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares, subject to further discussion on economic terms.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur no earlier than 90 days after signing and shall be subject to customary closing conditions, including completion of Buyer’s diligence and financing arrangements to the extent applicable.

3. Representations. The Seller represents and warrants, in addition to the financial statements, as to authority, title to the Shares, absence of undisclosed liabilities, compliance with law, taxes, litigation, and no material adverse change, in each case subject to customary qualifications.
